svg.title: Drosophila
svg.desc: Adult Drosophila in lateral view with red compound eye, segmented body, six jointed legs, antennae, and one visible wing pair. Biological basis: Drosophila melanogaster has a short generation time, powerful genetics, and conserved developmental and signaling pathways.
